title: Högertrafik
request: Verified Finnish roadway/traffic scene illustrating right-hand traffic; do not use a left-driving-country photo or infer a current traffic incident.

title: Till fots
request: Actual Finnish pedestrian street/footpath context; no real person assigned immigration or health status.

title: Trygg gångmiljö
request: Distinct accurately identified Finnish pedestrian environment; illustrative planning context,not a guarantee that a photographed route is safe now.

title: Övergångsställe och trafikljus
request: Actual Finnish pedestrian crossing/traffic signals with country identity verified; source says signals OFTEN,not at every crossing.

title: Landsbygd utan trottoar
request: Verified Finnish rural road with visible verge; no assertion that every rural road lacks a pavement or the current photographed route is safe.

title: Vänstra kanten
request: Under the preceding no-sidewalk context,a walker on the LEFT edge relative to their own travel direction; explicit direction arrows,not a reversed viewer-left convention or new distance rule.

title: Cykel
request: Actual bicycle used as a transport object; accurately identified,no brand recommendation.

title: En del cyklar på vintern
request: Verified actual winter cycling or bicycle-in-snow scene; source SOME riders,not a universal expectation or assertion of safe winter conditions.

title: Små barn på trottoaren
request: ONLY small-child cycling permission on sidewalk,with child/adult distinction; do not invent a numeric age limit absent from this source.

title: Cykelbana eller cykelfält
request: Actual Finnish cycle path/lane and recognisable relevant sign/markings; no invented lane layout or extra priority rule.

title: Om cykelbana saknas
request: Explicit IF no separate bike path/lane,cycling uses carriageway. Preserve the preceding ordinary-rider context,not an unconditional ride-anywhere rule.

title: Hjälm och lykta
request: Verified actual bicycle helmet and bicycle light objects,or carefully sourced composite; source darkness condition applies to the light. No asserted fit certification or invented light specification.

title: Kollektivtrafik i stora städer
request: Actual Finnish city public-transport scene without current schedule,route-frequency or ticket-price claims.

title: Buss, tåg, metro och spårvagn
request: Four correctly identified actual Finnish transport-mode images as a useful collage; no substituted intercity train for a specifically claimed local service or invented network map.

title: Olika biljetter
request: Single,series and monthly ticket categories as anonymous schematic objects; no fake valid fare media,price or invented official app interface.

title: Färre linjer, glesare trafik
request: Accurately identified smaller-town/rural public-transport setting,qualified by the exact source; no fabricated timetable or claim a pictured stop lacks service.

title: Resa runt i Finland
request: Actual Finnish bus/train/aircraft/boat example or varied collage; source MOST places,not guaranteed access to every location.

title: En del trafik går sällan
request: Qualitative sparse service marks on an unnumbered timeline; no invented departures,waiting times or route-specific timetable.

title: Kostnader för egen bil
request: Actual car/fuel-pump/maintenance object setting,with the stated insurance/tax categories in source text; no invented amounts or brand recommendation.

title: Vanligtvis ingen egen bil
request: Distinct large Finnish city transit/walkable context; preserve usually qualifier,not a ban or assertion about a real household's needs.

title: Bil kan behövas på mindre ort
request: Verified small-town/rural road and ordinary car setting; source MAY be needed,not a universal requirement or unsafe route recommendation.

title: Följ trafikreglerna
request: Accurate actual Finnish traffic-sign/road context; do not invent a speed limit,priority rule or official sign.

title: Polisens övervakning
request: Verified Finnish police vehicle or traffic camera/sign object; source IF rule violation then fine,no claim a photographed driver committed an offence.

title: Inte alkohol och bilkörning
request: Alcohol/driving prohibition relationship without depicting a real person as intoxicated,estimating safe drinks or suggesting a safe impairment level.

title: 0,5 promille i källan
request: Exact source0.5per-mille value with explicit promille unit; never convert to0.5percent or draw a green safe-to-drive zone below the limit.

title: Trafikförsäkring
request: IF owning a car,the source traffic-insurance obligation; anonymous policy document,not comprehensive-cover guarantees or invented premiums.

title: Försäkringsbolag
request: Verified actual Finnish insurance institution exterior if licensed,or neutral anonymous insurance-document object; no company endorsement or invented coverage.

title: Besiktning och registrering
request: BOTH inspection AND registration are source requirements; do not merge them into one event or insert frequency/deadline absent from source.

title: Besiktningsstation
request: Accurately identified actual Finnish vehicle-inspection station; not a car wash,repair shop or foreign licensing authority.

title: Registrering: exempel på platser
request: Three source example channels—inspection station,insurer,dealer—with clear for-example qualification. No invented mandatory single channel.

title: Traficoms webbplats
request: Verified actual Traficom institution or neutral computer object; no fake government interface,current URL/button flow or unprovided application result.

title: Giltigt körkort
request: ONLY with valid driving licence may one drive in the source context; clearly schematic anonymous card,no real identity or counterfeit-ready document.

title: Utfärdande stat erkänd av Finland
request: Issuing-state recognition as the source rule,with validity and later exceptions still visible in source context. No invented country-recognition map/list or unconditional all-card approval.

title: Bosatt vid utfärdandet
request: Explicit IF holder lived in Finland WHEN foreign card was issued,it is not accepted. Temporal residence/issuance gate,not a prohibition of all foreign licences.

title: Latinska bokstäver eller översättning
request: OR logic: Latin-letter licence text OR accompanied translation into Finnish/Swedish/English. No fictitious real card or claim other translations automatically suffice.

title: Ålders- och hälsokrav
request: BOTH Finnish age AND health requirements,unnumbered calendar and neutral health symbols; no invented minimum age,vision threshold,diagnosis or examination procedure.

title: EU/EES och giltighet
request: EU/EES-issued card AND still valid -> source driving permission for validity period. No invented member-country map or permission after expiry.

title: Byte: stadigvarande eller studier
request: CAN exchange in this EU/EES section IF permanent Finnish residence OR at least six months STUDY in Finland. Keep six-month study threshold tied to study,not all residence.

title: Byte efter giltighetstidens slut
request: For PASSENGER-CAR licence,exchange within two years AFTER validity expired; this is an exchange deadline,NOT permission to drive an expired card. Do not invent a calendar date.

title: Läkarutlåtande vid utgånget kort
request: IF expired card,a medical statement is needed; anonymous document,no real health record,diagnosis or extra testing threshold.

title: Konventionsland utanför EU
request: Outside-EU issuing country joined Geneva OR Vienna road-traffic convention -> source maximum two-year driving period in Finland. No invented start anchor,country list or extra duration.

title: Hongkong, Macao och Taiwan
request: Three exact source issuing-region names and maximum two years. No added sovereignty/recognition classification,border map or extension beyond source period.

title: Byte när stadigvarande bosatt
request: In the preceding convention/Hongkong/Macao/Taiwan context,CAN exchange when permanently resident. Do not generalize to every foreign licence regardless of later validity conditions.

title: Två år för bytet efter flytt
request: Move to Finland AND permanent residence start the stated two-year exchange window. Clearly label exchange deadline,not a fresh period of card validity.

title: Giltigt vid bytet
request: Card must be valid AT THE EXCHANGE moment in this source group; preserve distinction from the earlier EU/EES expired-card exchange statement.

title: Läkarutlåtande behövs också
request: Anonymous medical-statement document as an additional source requirement,not evidence of a person's health or an unprovided test result.

title: För sent eller ogiltigt kort
request: IF late exchange OR no longer valid -> Finnish driving examination containing BOTH theory AND driving tests. Explicit OR causes and AND test components,no costs or new exemptions.

title: Annat land: ett år från registrering
request: Issuing country joined NEITHER Geneva NOR Vienna convention -> one-year period AFTER Finnish population-system registration. Do not use arrival,permanent-move or card-expiry as a substituted start anchor.

title: Förarexamen för att fortsätta
request: AFTER that source one-year period,IF wishing to continue driving,complete Finnish driving examination. No automatic licence,extra delay or unprovided exam category.
